**Your app**
What it is and what it renders with (three.js, Cesium, Babylon, custom
WebGL, ...).

**What you want to embed or link**
The guest engine or app, and whether it goes in place (like a globe
replacing a sphere) or through a door.

**Constraints**
Same page or separate origin, trust level of the guest, performance
targets, mobile.
